text: Came in and ordered for an easy meal due to long day walking and competing in Jiujitsu comp, first off the self service machine was not working correctly making the whole experience go slower instead of the intended faster ordering, second of all when we got back to our hotel we noticed that half the changes we had made were not done to the order which in itself is frustrating as when you make the changes you expect them to be in there, missing multiple items of order...... thirdly the place was an absolute mess!! The floor was filthy, maple syrup all on windows sills and window, food all over the floor and bin not emptied. And there was a pigeon just walking around eating all the food off the floor 😞 the only thing that was good it was very speedy however think this was due to half our food missing!!!
author: Tahlia Waldren

text: Honestly shouldn't even have a star, came in during the morning, ordered nuggets in a large meal and breakfast burger on the side, takes a considerable amount of time to be ready, get our food, chips are cold, nuggets aren't fresh, when the manager explains to me that they are fresh, I see them pulling out the phu drawers, and had the nerve to argue and complain to me that they are fresh, didn't even get fresh nuggets as they refused. Absolutely disappointing, I've been in the fast food industry and this is just appalling customer service and food preparation.
author: Am4r4ntha

text:
I ordered from the kiosk and selected 2 sausage & egg muffins and a bottle of water. I selected table delivery. The kiosk didn't print a receipt.

They didn't deliver it. They called out the order in detail eventually. They said they were too busy to do table service.

The eggs in the muffins weren't fully cooked. I don't eat raw eggs. I threw them out. I didn't ask for replacements given the attitude already experienced and the poor quality delivered.

The worst McDs experience I've had in years...... and I travel a lot.

You've been warned.
author: Steve Withers

text:
This would have to be the Worst McDonald's in Australia if not the World, while I was waiting for my order which was completely wrong they had served nearly every other customer the wrong items because the McDonald's staff could not understand English or what other foreign people were saying. A number of the Customers were very irate because they were either not being served or being served the wrong food.
Have never been to a McDonald's like it.
author: Bob Wright

text:
Can’t comment on food as it has not arrived and it’s now over an hour since we ordered. Delivery was supposed to be between 12.20 and 12.40. Writing this review at 01.12. Tried to call store and get message saying they can’t take the call.
Update, food arrived at 01.30 and the order was incorrect. Can’t see any similarity between a pop top water which wasn’t ordered and a coke no sugar that was.

text: ordered mc muffin for take away, was surprised that my breakfast meal is damaged. the muffin was mouldy and burnt. this is the 3rd muffin that is burnt n very dry. i relayed this issue to the customer service, and they seemed not to care. next time, before taking your food out, please check the condition of your burger and reject if it is mouldy n burnt. or go to the nearest other Mc Donalds.
author: faustine margo

text: Absolutely appalling honestly ordered from this mcdonalds on uber eats for my Muslim friend who just ordered a burger and checked the ingredients before just to receive it with bacon on it for some reason?? Check your staffing and training procedures because heaven forbid what if this had happened with an allergy and someone died due to incompetence and laziness.
author: Amani El-Gammel

text: Complete and utter filth ordered my food that took ten minutes from order to takeaway then on top of that I get my food and my quarter pounder not only has the wrong sauce on it it’s also completely overloaded with it to the point it’s actually coming out of its box absolutely ridiculous that’s not to mention lack of respect from its workers complete rubbish

text: Ordered from uber eats… was excited for the frozen blueberry drink and the large choc frap which we paid extra for, ended up getting a Coke and a small coke. Didn’t get the Minecraft as well. One set of fries was missing. Probably got a lazy staff who didn’t care about it. I wonder what the manger is doing? Zero star if I could. AVOID!!!

text: Went through drive through early morning and waited several minutes only for noone to take our order.  We then went to the other windows and still no one appeared. As we drove through, we saw several workers in the store. As we were in a rush we were unable to get out to see what was happening. Really disappointing.

text:
Food was inedible. Cup lid wasn’t on properly and got 1/3 of a large coke and ice, grill slip was ignored despite paying extra for things, had to throw out the majority of the order as it was no longer safe to eat.

Don’t bother ordering online, they only pay attention to changes if the customer is in-front of them
author: Maddi DeWitt
